title: Mexican Turkey Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender turkey and spices, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the turkey neck and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the Ukrainian stew and bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
5. Stir in the zesty and dense spices.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
